Quesadilla - written by Izakbar. Some ideas taken from T.A.C.O.
Thank you to my wonderful testers : Paul Hipster Malcolmson, Ultimate-pilot Destiny and Zubenelgenubi.
Special thanks to : EVE-O Preview (https://github.com/EveOPlus/eve-o-preview) which has been invaluable for me when playing eve - and for working out how to find active eve clients. EVE Combat Log Analyzer (http://evelog.mikk36.eu/) made working out DPS a bit easier !
